goal: Make parallel-workstream reservations authoritative from the integration base and machine-check actual worker diffs/dependencies without changing Architecture Baseline v1 semantics.
baseline_impact: none; post-Baseline concurrency/integration guard implementation only
acceptance: Worker identity and write scope are reserved on the integration base before parallel implementation starts.
Actual worker diffs remain inside reserved paths plus the workstream's own control directory.
Reservation-defining fields cannot be expanded in the same worker implementation change.
Workstream dependencies exist, are acyclic and are integration-ready before dependent workstreams integrate.
Architecture Baseline v1 semantics remain unchanged.
